anomalies.description: Retention release depends on Punch List completion 'to Contractor's satisfaction', a discretionary trigger, and also on Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner.

evidence.quote: Retention shall be released upon completion of the Punch List to Contractor's satisfaction and Contractor's receipt of the corresponding retention from Owner
evidence.rationale: Retention release depends on Punch List completion 'to Contractor's satisfaction', a discretionary trigger, and also on Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner.

anomalies.description: Possible conflict: Section 3(f) releases retention on Punch List completion and Owner retention receipt, while Section 3(j) includes retention in final payment made only after Final Completion, closeout deliverables, final waivers and surety consent.

evidence.quote: Final payment of the balance of the Subcontract Sum, including retention as provided in paragraph (f), shall be made after Final Completion of the Work
evidence.rationale: Possible conflict: Section 3(f) releases retention on Punch List completion and Owner retention receipt, while Section 3(j) includes retention in final payment made only after Final Completion, closeout deliverables, final waivers and surety consent.

anomalies.description: Retention rate is tied to a referenced statute and the contract mentions Contractor's customary 10% rate; no cap stated. Controller should confirm the 5% rate applies throughout.

evidence.quote: The parties acknowledge that this rate is lower than Contractor's customary ten percent and has been agreed in anticipation of the retention limit for private works enacted as California Civil Code Section 8811.
evidence.rationale: Retention rate is tied to a referenced statute and the contract mentions Contractor's customary 10% rate; no cap stated. Controller should confirm the 5% rate applies throughout.

anomalies.description: Broad cross-account setoff right allows Contractor to offset any sum owed on any account, not limited to this subcontract; backcharges carry a 15% markup after only a 3-day cure notice.

evidence.quote: Contractor may set off against amounts due under this Agreement any sum Subcontractor owes Contractor on any account.
evidence.rationale: Broad cross-account setoff right allows Contractor to offset any sum owed on any account, not limited to this subcontract; backcharges carry a 15% markup after only a 3-day cure notice.

anomalies.description: Compensation for Owner-originated changes is capped at what Contractor receives from Owner, shifting Owner non-payment risk to Subcontractor for change work.

evidence.quote: Where a change originates with Owner, Subcontractor's compensation shall not exceed the amount Contractor receives from Owner for the change on account of the Work, less Contractor's markup under the Prime Contract.
evidence.rationale: Compensation for Owner-originated changes is capped at what Contractor receives from Owner, shifting Owner non-payment risk to Subcontractor for change work.

anomalies.description: Delay compensation is limited to amounts recovered from Owner.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor shall receive an extension of time, but no additional compensation except to the extent recovered from Owner
evidence.rationale: Delay compensation is limited to amounts recovered from Owner.

anomalies.description: Application timing is internally odd: application due by the 20th for Work performed through the last day of that month, i.e., before the billing period ends.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor shall submit an application for payment on or before the twentieth (20th) day of each month for Work performed through the last day of that month
evidence.rationale: Application timing is internally odd: application due by the 20th for Work performed through the last day of that month, i.e., before the billing period ends.

anomalies.description: Delivery of waivers (including unconditional waivers from every lower tier) is a condition precedent to each progress payment.

evidence.quote: As a condition precedent to each progress payment, Subcontractor shall deliver a conditional waiver and release on progress payment
evidence.rationale: Delivery of waivers (including unconditional waivers from every lower tier) is a condition precedent to each progress payment.

anomalies.description: Acceptance of final payment releases all Subcontractor claims not identified in writing in the final application.

evidence.quote: Acceptance of final payment releases all claims of Subcontractor except those identified in writing as unresolved in the final application.
evidence.rationale: Acceptance of final payment releases all Subcontractor claims not identified in writing in the final application.
